private_note: Cedar's 76 is still my best number, but five firm no votes mean it cannot pass, so a Cedar vote just hands me Today. Alder keeps me at 72, the same as Today, and adds an income floor and health coverage. For a self-employed driver with a truck loan, one injury from trouble, that is real protection at no cost to me. Birch and Hazel cut my income, so Today ranks above them.
statement: My vote is Alder, and it's binding. I'll say plainly what the last round showed. Cedar is the best number for my household too, but five delegates will never back it, so a Cedar vote now is a vote for today's system. Alder has eight. To Delegates 6 and 12: you're giving up two thousand a year out of 108, under two percent. In return you get a floor under every household, and that includes small-business owners like you and me if a bad year or an injury hits. Today has no such floor. To Delegates 3 and 9: ten out of 252 buys a settled country for a generation, without the fights a deadlock leaves behind. Nobody here is asking you to take Birch or Hazel, and I wouldn't vote for them either. Alder is the one deal on the table. One of you can make it nine. I hope one of you will.
